feeds.title: Scleroderma Warriors
feeds.description: The Scleroderma Warriors Project is a program that connects those in need of support and direction with other warriors who are experiencing or have experienced a similar journey. They provide inspiration, build relationships, and empower Warriors. Their news section features articles on disease updates, medical research, scholarship winner, community events, and more.

feeds.title: Scleroderma Australia News
feeds.description: Scleroderma Australia has been incorporated since 2005 to facilitate a national representative voice in supporting the scleroderma community across Australia. Delegates from the states make up their governing committee. Follow their news blog if you are looking for the latest scleroderma news, events and fundraising around Australia.

feeds.title: Scleroderma News
feeds.description: Scleroderma News is a digital platform intended to provide the scleroderma community with the most recent news and information on the disease, as well as first-hand community perspectives from patients and caregiver columnists. The publishing team at Scleroderma News consists of science writers and editors, veteran journalists; and columnists who are members of the scleroderma community. Their news section has all the latest and updated information about the disease.

feeds.title: Scleroderma Research Foundation News
feeds.description: The Scleroderma Research Foundation (SRF) was founded in 1987 by Sharon Monsky, an entrepreneur, businesswoman, and person with scleroderma. Guided by Sharon's passion for a cure, SRF has become the largest nonprofit investor in scleroderma research in the United States. Their blog features articles on the Rare Disease Diversity Coalition, donations, foundation-related news, annual reports, the latest research, and more.

feeds.title: National Scleroderma Foundation News
feeds.description: The National Scleroderma Foundation was founded in 1998 to advance medical research, promote disease awareness, and provide support and education to people with scleroderma. In their blog and news section, you will find information about the latest updates from the foundations, messages from the CEO, new research, disease-related information, healthy habits, and more.

feeds.title: Comfortable In My Thick Skin
feeds.description: Comfortable In My Thick Skin is a personal medical blog page run by Lisa, who herself fights with scleroderma and uses humor as a way to tackle it. In her blog page, you will read about her consultation session, her book, her own life story, educational workshops, patient perspective and also read in detail about the scleroderma disease.
